purpose: Convert controlled Cannabis-specific healthy/control and hard-negative imagery into provenance-complete review candidates without granting training or locked-evaluation eligibility.

target_material: Figure S1 Control whole-plant series by week
Figure S3 normal/control apical inflorescence development weeks 3-7
required_steps: acquire official supplementary ZIP from the publisher endpoint
record archive SHA-256 and exact source version
extract control panels while preserving figure/week/organ/treatment identity
record per-file SHA-256 and perceptual hash
assign one sourceGroupId covering all derivatives from the study/control cohort
bind labels only to source-authored Control/normal-development metadata
run human scientific, rights, and annotation review
admit to evaluation only after healthy-control coverage and split-policy thresholds are satisfied

work_items.source_title: Integrated Management of Pathogens and Microbes in Cannabis sativa L. (Cannabis) under Greenhouse Conditions
target_material: Figure 5 infected-versus-healthy root, flowering-plant, inflorescence, and dried-flower comparison panels
required_steps: verify exact figure/panel attribution under parent CC BY 4.0 terms
extract individual panels without losing infected/healthy side and figure identity
bind healthy/infected comparison labels only to source-authored captions and confirmation context
record SHA-256 and perceptual hashes
assign sourceGroupId and prevent paired panels from leaking across evaluation splits
run human scientific, rights, and annotation review
do not treat review-article visual attribution alone as a universal diagnosis ground truth

work_items.source_title: Entomopathogenic Fungi Effectively Control Phorodon cannabis Aphid Population in Cannabis sativa Plants
target_material: Greenhouse uninfested distilled-water control plants (Ct) across the three Cannabis cultivars
Greenhouse uninfested Beauveria-treated plants (N-B) as a treatment-specific non-aphid comparator where the source figure/caption supports the distinction
required_steps: acquire only article or supplementary child assets whose CC BY 4.0 attribution and figure identity are explicit
preserve cultivar, treatment code, infestation state, sampling time, figure/panel, and source-authored caption context
bind control labels only to the source-defined Ct or N-B treatment groups; never infer health from appearance alone
record per-file SHA-256 and perceptual hash before any crop or derivative is registered
assign one sourceGroupId for all panels and derivatives from this experiment so paired treatment images cannot leak across evaluation splits
separate organism-recognition imagery from plant-level healthy-control candidates when figure semantics differ
run human scientific, rights, and annotation review before any promotion
keep training and locked-evaluation eligibility false until split-policy coverage, duplicate isolation, and explicit admission review pass
